# Vultr Joins the Agentic AI Foundation to Advance Open, Interoperable Agentic AI

5 min readOctober 22, 2026

Agentic AI is moving from experimentation to production. Agents need to reason, call tools, access data, interact with other agents, and operate across distributed environments. Making that work requires more than models. It requires infrastructure, orchestration, frameworks, and open protocols that work together. [...] It also reinforces the point that AI infrastructure cannot be reduced to GPUs. GPUs are critical for training and inference, but CPUs handle application logic, orchestration, data processing, networking, agent execution, and many of the services surrounding the model.

Production agentic AI needs the full stack.

## Building an open, composable AI stack [...] The goal is not for every organization to use the same stack. It is to let developers choose a model, run it on the compute that best fits the workload, orchestrate it with Kubernetes, connect it to tools and data, and build agents on top – without a single provider controlling every layer.

No single company will build that ecosystem alone.
